mapper.sql: select p.*,null as topic_name from fund_allocation_plan p where p.del_flag='0'
mapper.select: and p.topic_id=#{topicId} and p.status=#{status} order by p.plan_time desc,p.plan_id desc
select coalesce(sum(plan_amount),0) from fund_allocation_plan where topic_id=#{topicId} and del_flag='0' and plan_id != #{excludePlanId}
select count(1) from fund_allocation_plan where topic_id=#{topicId} and del_flag='0'
mapper.update: update fund_allocation_plan set allocation_name=#{allocationName},allocation_dept_id=#{allocationDeptId},allocation_dept_name=#{allocationDeptName},receive_dept_id=#{receiveDeptId},receive_dept_name=#{receiveDeptName},plan_amount=#{planAmount},plan_time=#{planTime},fund_desc=#{fundDesc},update_by=#{updateBy},update_time=sysdate() where plan_id=#{planId} and del_flag='0'
update fund_allocation_plan set responsible_user_id=#{userId},responsible_user_name=#{userName},update_by=#{updateBy},update_time=sysdate() where plan_id=#{planId} and del_flag='0' and status='0'

update fund_allocation_plan set status='1',actual_amount=#{actual},difference_amount=#{difference},finish_type=#{finishType},finish_reason=#{reason},finish_user_id=#{finishUserId},finish_time=sysdate(),update_by=#{updateBy},update_time=sysdate() where plan_id=#{planId} and del_flag='0' and status='0'
update fund_allocation_plan set del_flag='2',update_time=sysdate() where plan_id=#{planId}
